task.description:
Write test specifications and integration test code for OBP-01, OBP-02, OBP-03, and DDL-03.

Read each requirement from docs/requirements.yaml and the design artefacts before writing specs.

**Test spec files to create:**
- tests/specs/OBP-01.md
- tests/specs/OBP-02.md
- tests/specs/OBP-03.md
- tests/specs/DDL-03.md

Each spec must:
- Have one TC per acceptance criterion (named TC-<REQ>-AC<N>)
- Describe fixture setup, action (GIVEN/WHEN/THEN), and expected outcome
- Be self-sufficient and isolated (no shared state across TCs)
- Not SkipZigTest any MUST-priority ACs

**Integration test files to create (Zig):**

For OBP-01 (tests/integration/obp01_depth_cache_test.zig):
- TC-OBP-01-AC1: drainer writes fresh count (≤250ms behind table)
- TC-OBP-01-AC2: readCached() adds <1ms (no SELECT count(*) on request path)
- TC-OBP-01-AC3: stale cache (>5s) treats as at-cap
- TC-OBP-01-AC4: tenant B unaffected when tenant A is at-cap
- TC-OBP-01-AC5: BPM_OUTBOX_DEPTH_CAP and BPM_OUTBOX_LOW_WATER in .env.example

For OBP-02 (tests/integration/obp02_ingress_refusal_test.zig):
- TC-OBP-02-AC1: 429 with Retry-After:5; no idempotency key row when at-cap
- TC-OBP-02-AC2: same key processes normally after gate reopens
- TC-OBP-02-AC3: no transaction opened, no pool connection taken
- TC-OBP-02-AC4: status code 429 not 400/500/503
- TC-OBP-02-AC5: Retry-After header unconditional
- TC-OBP-02-AC6: EXECUTION_INGRESS_REFUSED appended to event log

For OBP-03 (tests/integration/obp03_outbox_overflow_test.zig):
- TC-OBP-03-AC1: emit() returns OutboxOverflow; no row inserted; step rolls back
- TC-OBP-03-AC2: build fails if caller omits OutboxOverflow from error set
- TC-OBP-03-AC3: retry policy applied to OutboxOverflow (no separate rate limiter)
- TC-OBP-03-AC4: runaway producer backs off (depth falls while drainer catches up)
- TC-OBP-03-AC5: dead-letter entry carries OutboxOverflow + attempt count + depth per attempt
- TC-OBP-03-AC6: dead-lettered instance retries with pinned definition version

For DDL-03 (tests/integration/ddl03_phased_generation_test.zig or unit tests in src/platform/ddl_generate.zig):
- TC-DDL-03-AC1: three phases emitted; phase 3 references constraint from phase 1
- TC-DDL-03-AC2: phase 1 ADD COLUMN NULL + ADD CONSTRAINT NOT VALID
- TC-DDL-03-AC3: phase 3 VALIDATE CONSTRAINT + SET NOT NULL references correct constraint name
- TC-DDL-03-AC4: PhaseGenerationFailed for disallowed change
- TC-DDL-03-AC5: only constraint target column changes trigger three-phase generation
- TC-DDL-03-AC6: deterministic constraint name <table>_<column>_nn

**Wire tests into build.zig** following the pattern used by other test-integration-* steps.

Commit the test files to feature/WF02-obp-ddl-20260817.

result.summary: Test specs and integration test code for OBP-01, OBP-02, OBP-03, DDL-03. Spec files written for all 4 requirements (5 TCs each for OBP-01/02/03, 6 TCs for DDL-03). DDL-03 new unit tests added to src/platform/ddl_generate.zig (TC-AC4c, TC-AC5, TC-AC6 named variants). OBP unit tests already in src modules. Three integration test files created: obp01_depth_cache_test.zig (AC1/AC3/AC5), obp02_ingress_refusal_test.zig (AC1-AC6), obp03_outbox_overflow_test.zig (AC1-AC6). Build.zig wired with outbox_emit_mod named module and three new integration test targets. lint_test_isolation.py exit 0; lint_handoffs.py exit 0.

issues.description: gate.flushRefusalEvents() is specified in src/design/obp-02-ingress-refusal.md but not yet implemented in src/outbox/gate.zig (gate.zig has no flushRefusalEvents function). TC-OBP-02-AC6 integration test verifies the event_type_registry seed (migration 1167) is present, which is the pre-condition for the flush. Full end-to-end async append test requires BACKEND-DEV to implement flushRefusalEvents before TEST-RUNNER executes.

TC-OBP-03-AC3 (retry policy unchanged) and TC-OBP-03-AC6 (pinned version on retry) require engine-level integration (full instance retry loop + DLQ dead-letter path). The integration tests in obp03_outbox_overflow_test.zig cover the compile-time type assertion for AC3 and the instance_projections schema pre-condition for AC6. Full engine-level retry loop tests are deferred to TEST-RUNNER once the engine wires OutboxOverflow through its failure path.

Security review minor finding forwarded: Migration 1167 missing EXECUTION_INGRESS_REFUSED event_type_registry seed (non-blocking per step-02a). TC-OBP-02-AC6 will fail if the seed is absent when TEST-RUNNER executes against a DB without migration 1167.
